subject: Unify /search: gate annotates instead of suppressing; single pipeline both paths
description: Refactor daemon.js /search so gated and ungated share one retrieval pipeline (DAG tier, temporal filter, hybrid scoring, structBoost rerank, path provenance, top-k). gateTask() consumes pre-scored candidates (no re-scoring) and returns annotation only: decision/reason/metrics + inject:true flags. Abstain returns full bundle, unflagged. Update MCP tool description, context-gate-regression + search-knowledge tests to assert decision+flags instead of empty results. Gate verdict calibration must not drift. See note:note-mqacft0tdqh.
